# Victor Jimenez portfolio

> Enterprise CMS Architect with 13+ years of Drupal and WordPress experience.

## About

I build Drupal and WordPress platforms, with a focus on architecture, migrations, full-stack delivery, performance and accessibility. I lead technical planning, implementation and release verification across CMS projects.

## Expertise

- CMS Migrations: legacy CMS and WordPress multisite migrations with repeatable pipelines
- Performance: Varnish, Redis, CDNs, Core Web Vitals optimization
- Accessibility: WCAG AA audits, semantic HTML, ARIA compliance
- Decoupled Architecture: React/Next.js frontends with Drupal/WordPress APIs
- Workflow automation: requirements analysis, local environments and release verification

## Project experience

My professional project contributions span media, healthcare, higher education, publishing, commerce, hospitality, financial services and public-interest websites. These examples represent work delivered as part of project teams and are grouped by sector.

My public personal projects include Project Context Connector for Drupal, Project Context Connector for WordPress and VictorStack technical writing and automation projects.
